select common_client_ip, common_server_ip, common_start_time, http_url, http_host, http_domain, ssl_sni, ssl_cn from `connection_record_log_local` where common_start_time >= (#{found_time} - #{startInterval}) and common_start_time <= (#{found_time} + #{endInterval}) and common_client_ip = #{client_ip} and (common_schema_type='HTTP' or common_schema_type='SSL')
